verdict.rationale: Viam is a robotics platform (not itself an agent), so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis, but the evidence pack shows only generic agent/CLI/SDK access (viam-docs-12, viam-docs-13) with no mention of MCP anywhere, and a probe confirms no discoverable OpenAPI/MCP endpoint (viam-probe-2). Missing for 10: any documented MCP server implementation, MCP registry listing, or first-party MCP integration guide.
